approved_scope.title: Keep archived foreign change directories outside adoption validation and import
approved_scope.description: Keep archived foreign change directories outside adoption validation and import
acceptance_criteria: For both OpenSpec and Spec Kit, preview and import ignore a symlink inside the real top-level archive directory and reject a symlink in an active change. Preview and refusal leave the destination unchanged. Real adoption imports only active content.

answers.constraints: REQ-change-014 requires safe foreign import, an untouched destination on refusal, and archives preserved in place. Keep previews metadata-only and never follow a foreign symlink.

relayed_by.words: I inspected #1151’s new scope and fixes. Approve the scope and archive when native verification passes.
relayed_by.where: Maintainer response in the SpecSync 6.4.2 release conversation, 2026-11-24 UTC, after inspecting the new scope and fixes at 01752687 in PR #1151.
